description: This file defines the TabsAdapter class, a helper class that manages tab interactions and connects a ViewPager with a TabHost in an Android application. It implements tab switching logic, view management, and synchronization between tabs and pages.

classes.name: TabsAdapter
classes.description: A class that manages tab interactions and synchronizes a ViewPager with a TabHost in an Android app.

classes.name: DummyTabFactory
classes.description: A factory class that creates dummy views for tabs to satisfy TabHost requirements without displaying actual content.

methods.name: addTab
methods.description: Adds a new tab with a specified TabSpec and associated view.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of tabs managed by the adapter.

methods.name: instantiateItem
methods.description: Creates and adds the view for a given tab position into the container.

methods.name: destroyItem
methods.description: Removes the view for a given tab position from the container.

methods.name: isViewFromObject
methods.description: Checks if a view corresponds to a specific object.

methods.name: setOnTabChangedListener
methods.description: Sets a listener to be notified when the tab changes.

methods.name: onTabChanged
methods.description: Handles tab change events, updating the ViewPager and notifying external listeners.

methods.name: onPageScrolled
methods.description: Callback for when the page is scrolled (not implemented).

methods.name: onPageSelected
methods.description: Handles page selection, updating the tab focus and scrolling the tab into view.

methods.name: onPageScrollStateChanged
methods.description: Callback for scroll state changes (not implemented).
